info.title: TNTC
info.description: TNTC is a command-line tool designed to help manage translations in .NET projects.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract all strings from all sources, refresh their source locations, and queue the ones that have no translation yet.

options.name: --languages
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to work on. Defaults to all of them: cs, de, fr, es, el, he, hi, it, ja, ko, ms, ne, nl, pl, pt, ru, sr, sv, uk, zh

arguments.name: PROJECTFOLDER
arguments.description: Project folder to look for project to translate within. Any folder with a '.tnt' folder is a folder to be translated.

commands.name: missing
commands.description: Write the strings that still need a translation to a batch file, for a translator to fill in and hand to 'apply'.

options.name: --languages
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to work on. Defaults to all of them: cs, de, fr, es, el, he, hi, it, ja, ko, ms, ne, nl, pl, pt, ru, sr, sv, uk, zh

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of strings to write out. 0 (the default) writes all of them.

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write the batch to. Writes to standard output when omitted.

options.name: --include-unused
options.description: Also include strings no source file references any more. Off by default.

options.name: --retranslate
options.description: Comma-separated states whose translations should be redone even though they carry text, e.g. 'New,NeedsReview'. Known states: New, NeedsReview, GPT4oMiniGenerated, NeedsReviewTranslation, Translated, Final, LLMGenerated, ClaudeSkillGenerated

arguments.name: PROJECTFOLDER
arguments.description: Project folder to look for project to translate within. Any folder with a '.tnt' folder is a folder to be translated.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Merge a filled-in batch file back into the translation files, rejecting any translation that changed a placeholder, a tag, a link or the surrounding whitespace.

options.name: --model
options.description: The Claude model id that produced the translations, recorded on each record as 'GeneratedBy'.

options.name: --state
options.description: The state to record the translations under. Known states: New, NeedsReview, GPT4oMiniGenerated, NeedsReviewTranslation, Translated, Final, LLMGenerated, ClaudeSkillGenerated

options.name: --allow-warnings
options.description: Accept translations that only raise warnings (whitespace and tag-attribute differences). Off by default.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite translations that were reviewed (Final / Translated). Off by default.

arguments.name: PROJECTFOLDER
arguments.description: Project folder to look for project to translate within. Any folder with a '.tnt' folder is a folder to be translated.

arguments.name: BATCHFILE
arguments.description: The batch file written by 'missing', with the translations filled in.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check that every translation file parses and that every translation on file kept the original's placeholders, markup, links and whitespace.

options.name: --languages
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to work on. Defaults to all of them: cs, de, fr, es, el, he, hi, it, ja, ko, ms, ne, nl, pl, pt, ru, sr, sv, uk, zh

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings (whitespace and tag-attribute differences) as errors too.

arguments.name: PROJECTFOLDER
arguments.description: Project folder to look for project to translate within. Any folder with a '.tnt' folder is a folder to be translated.

commands.name: upgrade-from-tnt
commands.description: Upgrade the existing TNT translations to the new json format

arguments.name: PROJECTFOLDER
arguments.description: Project folder to look for project to translate within. Any folder with a '.tnt' folder is a folder to be translated.
